jsonforms-special-browse-forms-descripti:
Here you can create/edit form descriptors and schemas. A form, in the context of JsonForms, is a wrapper for a schema containing parameters used to define the article editing or creation. A form can be used both as a parser function (in the format {{#jsonforms:
}}) to display it anywhere on the wiki, or as a parameter of the special page [[Special:JsonForms]] (e.g. [[Special:JsonForms/NewContact|New contact]]).
jsonforms-special-browse-error-invalid-f:
invalid form descriptor, ensure to run 
php extensions/JsonForms/maintenance/ImportData.php
to import default forms and schemas
jsonforms-special-browse-schemas-descrip: Here you can create/edit [https://json-schema.org/specification json-schema]'s compliant schemas for the use inside form descriptors, manually or through the Schema builder. The Schema builder is created using this [[JsonSchema:SchemaBuilder/MetaSchema|meta-schema]] and AI agents can be prompted to create draft-schemas using it as a reference.
jsonforms-formschema-form-combined-desc: Main slot + one slot for data

jsonforms-formschema-infobox-template-de: Template to use (leave empty for automatic generation)
jsonforms-formschema-print-scalar-desc: Print scalar values if the related template is not found
jsonforms-formschema-form-data-only-desc: The data will be saved in the main slot as json content-model.
jsonforms-editor-cannot-add-property-det: . This may indicate that the meta-schema has not been designed to handle this schema and therefore it shouldn't be edited through it.
